name: Aleph-4
summary: Aleph-4, or ALEPH-4, also known as 4-isopropylthio-2,5-dimethoxyamphetamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families. It is one of the Aleph series of compounds.

uses.text: The drug was encountered as a novel designer drug in Japan in 2009.

pharmacology.en: It has been little studied. Like other psychedelics of the DOx family, it is thought to work mainly by activating serotonin 5-HT2A receptors.
pharmacology.zh: 它很少被研究。和其他 DOx 家族的迷幻藥一樣，一般認為它主要透過活化血清素 5-HT2A 受體發揮作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它很少被研究。和其他 DOx 家族的迷幻药一样，一般认为它主要通过活化血清素 5-HT2A 受体发挥作用。

sideEffects.en: Very little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of its family, the DOx amphetamines, tend to be long lasting and can cause anxiety, confusion, a raised heart rate and blood pressure, and difficult experiences.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響幾乎沒有資料。同家族的 DOx 類安非他命迷幻藥作用時間通常很長，可能引起焦慮、混亂、心跳與血壓上升，以及難受的經驗。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响几乎没有数据。同家族的 DOx 类安非他命迷幻药作用时间通常很长，可能引起焦虑、混乱、心跳与血压上升，以及难受的经验。

fact.en: Aleph-4 is one of the Aleph compounds that Alexander Shulgin described in PiHKAL. It carries an isopropyl group on its sulphur atom.
fact.zh: Aleph-4 是 Alexander Shulgin 在《PiHKAL》中描述的 Aleph 系列化合物之一，它的硫原子上接著一個異丙基。
fact.zhHans: Aleph-4 是 Alexander Shulgin 在《PiHKAL》中描述的 Aleph 系列化合物之一，它的硫原子上接着一个异丙基。
